title: icalendar corpus index
description: Machine-readable manifest of the icalendar cases, so a runner in any language consumes the corpus without parsing prose.

spec.description: The normative document this corpus is the executable form of.

file.description: Case path relative to this directory. No path separators in the filename, so an entry cannot reach outside the corpus.

section.description: The specification section this case pins. Subsection-capable, and it must be: icalendar.md has §3.1-§3.3, §4.1, §4.2, §5.1-§5.5 and §7.1. A chapter-only pattern could not name any of them.
